lucy: Uploaded a short Q4 recurring-incident synthesis (link in thread). Main ask: assign owners + rough ETA for top 4 patterns so we can prioritize fixes for next sprint. https://redwood.internal/docs/q4-recurrence :spiral_note_pad:

thomas: i'll take 'model shard cache thrash' — plan a spike to validate prewarm + eviction thresholds. aim to share findings by Wed.

maria: i'll own 'retry amplification from flaky SDKs'. will sync with SDK team tomorrow and propose server-side circuit breaker thresholds first.

devin: i'll handle 'noisy alert noise' and 'false positives on infra flaps'. will produce a consolidated rule list and suppression plan in 5 business days.

samir: quick question: do we want to track estimated customer impact per theme? i think a rough hours metric helps prioritize.

lucy: yes — added 'est_cust_hrs' in the doc. please fill in a number when you create your epic. also create one JIRA epic per theme and paste link into the doc column 'Epic'.

incident-bot: Snapshot created: recurring-q4-1805600000 (11 incidents).
https://redwood.internal/incidents/catalog/1805600000

thomas: filing epic RW-INC-9100 for cache-thrash. added est_cust_hrs ~ 30.

maria: filed RW-INC-9101 for retry work, target canary 2023-11-15. est_cust_hrs ~ 18.

devin: I'll file the alert consolidation epic tomorrow and link it.

lucy: Action summary: thomas (cache) spike by Wed, maria (retry) canary target 11/15, devin (alerts) audit in 5 days. i'll run a 15-min weekly sync until resolved. ping me if anything slips. :calendar:
